pages.text: A water block changes into ice in the cold. Repeating that change needs not only cold and time, but a renewed supply of water.

pages.title: Shaping the Pattern
pages.text: Use a sample at the center of a blank mimic, with these materials around it:$(br2)Water Bucket ×2$(br)Rune Plate: Material Manifestation$(br)Rune Plate: Sequence and Delay$(br)Rune Plate: Recognizing Conditions
